scientific_integrity: The finite-time and limiting claims are supported by an analytic orthogonal martingale decomposition; finite exact-rational enumeration independently checks illustrative cases but is not a substitute for the proof. Prior work already considers convergence to random exact solutions; the assessed advance is the quantified doubly sampled variance law and its all-schedule strict lower bound. Equivalence in inaccessible historical literature cannot be ruled out.
scientific_limitations: Exact real, rank-one, consistent data with independent uniform row/coordinate sampling and deterministic positive stepsizes. The all-schedule claim requires every step smaller than the inverse largest squared row coefficient and divergent cumulative steps. It does not cover general rank-deficient matrices, independent observation noise, or adaptive indices.
title: Exact nullspace-variance law for doubly randomized coordinate descent on rank-one inverse problems
